headline: PROPERTY and PF&REIT dominate risk flags as PF and M-STOR collapse on heavy volume, with XBIO under SET clarification
market_take: Pervasive downside across coverage yesterday, led by extreme -20.00% drops in PF (PROP) and GEL (CONMAT) and a -17.22% slide in M-STOR (PF&REIT) on vol×5.26. CONS names are broadly weak with five decliners, while PF&REITs show heavy but mixed flow including new unit listings from PROSPECT. FOOD is quiet apart from the XBIO clarification flag, and the only notable outright winners are RML, CGD and A in PROP on elevated volume.

sector_notes.note: Six of fifteen top movers are PROP; PF -20.00%, EVER -12.50%, J -5.75% on the downside, while A +12.64% (vol×4.9) and RML +11.11% (vol×5.9) stand out as upside outliers. AWC carried a 6.0σ volume spike alongside a 25-Sep subsidiary establishment and asset acquisition filing.

M-STOR plunged -17.22% on vol×5.26 with a 6.9σ spike and -15.56% open gap, and TIF1 hit a 10.5σ volume spike. PROSPECT new units trade 30-Sep, MII reported rights offering results, and WHART/HPF filed valuation and asset disclosures.
XBIO -16.67% on vol×0.22 but flagged with a SET clarification request filed today, and NSL posted a 3.8σ volume spike. TKN filed two share repurchase reports on 25-Sep and 28-Sep.
Five CONS decliners led by PLE -14.29% with a -14.29% open gap; SQ -5.56% also opened -11.11% down before closing +6.25% intraday. TPOLY -9.09% follows a 25-Sep bondholders' meeting resolution.

GEL -20.00% with a -20.00% open gap, while UMI showed a 4.5σ volume spike paired with a +6.59% open gap. DCON filed an AGM/EGM shareholder-rights notice on 28-Sep, and TPIPL disclosed a revised connected lease transaction (high significance) on 25-Sep.
